profile.headline: Software Engineer | Backend | Java  | Microservices and APIs | React
profile.summary:
As a software engineer with five years of experience in full-stack development, I have crafted and maintained robust web applications. My technology journey began with a passion for video games and computers, gradually evolving into a keen interest in software and its problem-solving capabilities.

I have successfully developed various types of applications, ranging from monolithic applications to mobile applications for Android using Kotlin, as well as maintaining and creating applications in React. Currently, I specialize in microservices-based architecture, utilizing technologies such as GCP (Google Cloud Platform), GitHub Actions for CI/CD, Spring Web for backend development, Postgres for database management, and Pub/Sub for messaging services. I consistently strive to uphold clean, maintainable code while employing agile practices to ensure software quality.

In my current role, I have contributed to building a new application from scratch, leading to the decommissioning of outdated applications. This project has enhanced user experience through the adoption of cutting-edge technologies. Leveraging continuous integration and deployment tools, along with observability applications and metrics such as Grafana and Prometheus, we have achieved better application control and minimized bugs.

Beyond my day-to-day work, I am passionate about learning new technologies and staying updated with the latest development tools. I enjoy taking new courses and keeping abreast of software development trends to continually advance professionally.

Skills and experience
Java - 3+ years
React - 2+ years
Golang - 1+ years
Kotlin - 1+ years
Spring - 2+ years
Git and Github - 5+ years
NoSQL Database (Cloudant) - 1+ years
SQL Database (Postgres) - 2+ years
Grafana and prometheus - 1+ years
Google Cloud Platform - 2+ years
